shared_elements: row or band of repeated schematic signs
justification: The most specific shared content is a linear band or row of repeated schematic marks/signs, with both surfaces using simplified incised/outlined motifs rather than fully naturalistic rendering. The biggest difference is that B contains many recognizable figurative motifs—animals, birds or reptiles, and possible human/body forms arranged in registers—whereas A appears mostly as an eroded band of abstract or glyph-like geometric carving with no clearly matching figures.
